doc.title: Chris Parker interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 5, 2023

title: Closing compliments and goodbyes
summary: Rowe quotes Tom Hanks and Tom Scott's praise and the two say thanks and Happy New Year.

story.theme_name: Thanks and goodbyes: closing the interview
story.community_name: Closing thanks and goodbyes at the end of the interview

blocks.x: All right. Well you’ve been very generous with your time, and here’s two quotes that I now agree with:
That Tom Hanks said about you, “The hardest working man in show business.” And from Tom Scott, “The sweetest human being on the planet.”
So you can live on that for the rest of the day, at least I would.
Yeah, definitely. I appreciate your time, Monk, thanks so much for having me on the show and for interviewing. This has been great.
Well good. I’ve really enjoyed it and I wish you all the best.
All right. Same to you. Happy New Year.
